page: Microsoft Azure DC16eds_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEDV6 family, built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Intel processors. This instance features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-speed local disk access for temporary or scratch data. It is also capable of utilizing Premium Storage for external disk volumes. The instance does not include any dedicated graphics processing units (GPUs) and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC16eds_v6 balances dedicated compute resources with a substantial local NVMe storage allocation, making it suitable for workloads requiring fast local read and write operations without the overhead of external storage. Given its memory allocation and local storage capacity, this instance is designed for memory-optimized workloads, database hosting, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated CPU execution and fast local scratch space.
